Author: Rajeev Misra
Bench: Rajeev Misra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:3781
Court No. - 71
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 42949 of 2024
Applicant :- Mohd Suhail Azam And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Zaid Arshad
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Misra,J.
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard Mr. Zaid Arshad, the learned counsel for applicants, the learned A..G.A. for State-opposite
party-1 and Mr. Zafar Ahmad Khan Advocate holding brief of Mr. Meraj Ahmad Khan, Advocate,
who has put in appearance on behalf of first informant/opposite party-2 by filing a counter affidavit
alongwith his vakalatnama in court today, which is taken on record.

3. Applicants-Mohd Suhail Azam and Anjum Suhail, have approached this Court by means of present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C with the following prayer:
Mohd Suhail Azam And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74188975/
1 " It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble court may graciously be pleased to quash the impugned charge sheet dated 13.03.2022 and stay the entire proceeding against applicant in Case No. 1094 of 2022 arising out of Case Crime No.
730/2021, under Section 376, 313, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. Police Station Kareili, District Allahabad, pending in the court of Special Chief Judicial Magistrate, Allahabad,
otherwise the applicant shall suffer an irreparable loss and injury.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: And/or to pass such other and further order which this Hon'ble Court may deed fit and proper on the facts and circumstances of the case.

"
4. At the very outset, the learned counsel for applicants submits that during the pendency of aforementioned criminal case, parties amicably settled their dispute out side the court.
On the basis of settlement so arrived at between the parties, a compromise was entered into.

Subsequently, the compromise so entered into by the parties was reduced in writing by way of a compromise deed dated 07.09.2024.
5.

At this juncture, the Court raised a pointed query as to whether the said compromise, copy of the which has been brought on record as Annexure-3 to the affidavit filed in support of this application has been filed before court below or not.
Learned counsel for applicants fairly submits that the said compromise has not yet been filed before court below.

7. In view of above, this application is misconceived at this stage and is therefore liable to be dismissed at this stage with liberty to applicants to file a fresh application under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
after the compromise entered into by the parties has been duly filed before court below.
8. The present application is accordingly dismissed at this stage with liberty aforesaid.

Order Date :- 8.1.2025 YK  Mohd Suhail Azam And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74188975/
